title: Rspack vs esbuild: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Rspack vs esbuild: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: Rspack leverages Rust for unparalleled build speeds, often outperforming esbuild in large codebases.
• Latency: Both offer low latency, but Rspack's incremental compilation can provide faster subsequent builds.
• Consistency: Rspack's plugin system offers more predictable outcomes and fewer edge cases than esbuild's.
• Failure Modes: Rspack's robust design minimizes unexpected crashes; esbuild is generally stable but can be more brittle.
• Operational Overhead: Rspack might have a slightly higher initial setup complexity, but its performance gains reduce long-term overhead.

Recommendation: For production environments demanding high throughput and consistent scalability, Rspack is the superior choice.
